description: A driver sits on a red tractor beside a trailer loaded with sacks.
reason: Useful mechanisation context; driver is in deep shade and framing is equipment-led.

description: Over-the-shoulder view of a person using a tablet in an agricultural input shop.
reason: Sharp tablet-led composition, warm lighting and strong depth; no identifiable face is visible.

description: The same tablet-and-input-shop photograph as image 2.
reason: Byte-identical duplicate of image 2; retain the original but do not create a second derivative.

description: A woman holds pineapples while standing in a pineapple field.
reason: Strong human subject, authentic crop context, good subject separation and ample resolution.

description: A composite collage combines phones, a pineapple farmer, portraits and agricultural input scenes.
reason: Mixed-resolution embedded panels, uneven crops and text make the collage unsuitable as a single coherent web photograph; its very large canvas does not imply sharp source panels.

description: A speaker addresses an outdoor gathering from a lectern beneath a canopy.
reason: Clear event documentation; busy background and canopy limit flexible hero cropping.

description: A cap-wearing speaker uses a microphone beside a lectern and laptop.
reason: Useful presentation detail, but backdrop and partial attendees make a smaller placement preferable.

description: Seated attendees, including a person in patterned ceremonial clothing, watch an outdoor event.
reason: Good documentary coverage; several competing subjects and shade favour an editorial card.

description: Front-row attendees sit beneath the event canopy.
reason: Clear group detail but busy edges, harsh bright areas and seated composition are not hero-led.

description: Rows of attendees sit under a canopy, with a blue-shirted attendee in the foreground.
reason: Useful audience context; foreground occlusion and crowded scene suit smaller sections.

description: A second nearly identical view shows the seated canopy audience.
reason: Visually redundant with image 10 and softer foreground detail; this is a near-duplicate selection judgment, not a byte-identical duplicate.

description: A side view shows several rows of attendees facing the event stage.
reason: Distinct audience angle and good documentary value; limited negative space for a hero.

description: Attendees in the front rows look down at printed material or phones.
reason: Useful participation detail, but mixed gazes and busy framing favour a smaller crop.

description: Two colleagues pose together outdoors on grass.
reason: Clear informal team portrait; background activity and hard daylight reduce hero versatility.

description: Three colleagues pose outdoors beside the event canopy.
reason: Good human-scale team image for cards; not a wide storytelling composition.

description: A small group participates in a ribbon-cutting ceremony.
reason: Meaningful event moment; bright clipped areas and crowded framing limit full-width use.

description: A staff member assists a customer across a computer counter in an orange-walled shop.
reason: Strong service interaction, clear composition, useful negative space and ample resolution.

description: Shelves display rows of packaged agricultural input bottles.
reason: Sharp input-stock detail for a small section; repetitive packaging is not a strong homepage story. Agricultural inputs, not harvested produce.

description: Shop shelves hold boxed sprayers and agricultural input bottles.
reason: Useful input-retail context for cards; plain shelving and mixed products lack a hero focal point. Agricultural inputs, not harvested produce.

description: A shelving unit contains input bottles, bags and packaged agricultural products.
reason: Distinct wider inventory view suitable for a supporting section, not a full-width lead. Agricultural inputs, not harvested produce.

description: A darker angle shows the same input-shop shelving and sprayer boxes.
reason: Underlit compared with images 19 and 20, with redundant subject coverage and weaker product separation.

description: Five people pose in front of a roofed terminal building.
reason: Useful small group portrait; flat daylight and busy roof structure limit hero use.

description: A larger group poses outside the terminal building.
reason: Good community-event documentation; many small faces and little negative space.

description: A second frame shows almost the same terminal-building group as image 23.
reason: Near-duplicate of image 23 with less balanced spacing and bright empty edge area; no additional coverage benefit.

description: A large community group poses standing and kneeling outside a building.
reason: Strong attendance record, best suited to an event recap rather than a homepage hero.

description: Another frame shows the same standing and kneeling community group.
reason: Near-duplicate of image 25; retain one selected frame to avoid redundant derivatives.

description: A colleague in a cap and branded polo poses outdoors with another person behind.
reason: Portrait-oriented team detail; background person and tight framing are better for a smaller placement.

description: Three colleagues wearing matching grey shirts pose on grass.
reason: Useful team-card photograph; flat light and informal setting are not hero-led.

description: A vertical full-length portrait shows three colleagues in matching grey shirts.
reason: Alternative portrait crop to image 28 for narrow placements; not suitable for a wide hero.

description: A broad staff group poses in front of an Esoko Farmer Terminal sign.
reason: Clear organisational context, but tightly packed people and signage favour a supporting section.

description: A smaller staff group poses beneath the Esoko Farmer Terminal sign.
reason: Distinct smaller-group record; bright concrete and busy signage limit hero flexibility.

description: A staff line-up poses at the Farmer Terminal, with several people looking sideways.
reason: Near-duplicate of image 33 with less settled poses and inconsistent gazes; prefer image 33.

description: A line of colleagues poses together in front of the Farmer Terminal.
reason: Useful selected team group; mixed expressions and bright ground make a smaller placement preferable.

description: A colleague poses beside a maize-product poster outside a shop.
reason: Narrow contextual portrait; face is shaded, so keep use small and avoid full-width display.

description: Two colleagues lean together beside the maize-product poster.
reason: Warm informal interaction for a team section; portrait framing and shade limit a wide hero.

description: A colleague poses by a shop window and agricultural-product posters.
reason: Usable narrow team portrait; doorway and posters compete with the subject.

description: A large group poses inside an office with a tiled floor.
reason: Low light, visible noise and soft facial detail make this weaker than the outdoor group alternatives.

description: A distant group poses outside the Esoko office under the building sign.
reason: Distant faces and strong bright/shaded contrast; redundant with the clearer, closer exterior group in image 40.

description: An office group stands close together beneath a covered entrance.
reason: Useful close group variation, but shaded faces and crowded composition are better at supporting size.

description: A group poses across the Esoko office entrance and steps.
reason: Best-balanced exterior office-group frame in this HEIC sequence; supporting use rather than a wide hero.

description: A further frame shows the same group at the office entrance.
reason: Near-duplicate of image 40 with no meaningful additional subject coverage; prefer the selected balanced frame.

description: An overhead view shows helpline staff working at computers in a bright office.
reason: Distinctive operational composition, strong workstation geometry and ample resolution; some faces remain visible.

description: Cupped hands hold pale maize kernels against colourful fabric.
reason: Strong intimate crop detail, but only 969px wide: use for cards, never upscale to a 1440px hero.

description: Three headset-wearing helpline agents work at computer stations.
reason: Clear human service story, sharp foreground subject and good depth at 3000px wide.

description: A field agent shows printed material to a small group beside crops.
reason: Relevant field interaction, but busy background and comparatively limited 1928px width favour a supporting placement.

description: A seller and an orange-shirted agent use a tablet beside maize at a market stall.
reason: Strong real-world technology interaction, warm light, clear crop context and ample resolution.

description: A feature-phone product graphic displays an Esoko weather-alert SMS.
reason: Useful illustrative SMS example, not documentary photography; 590px width limits it to a small inset.
